about.en: Claus (CLAUS) is the token of the Claus project, an AI agent that runs its own token, an onchain City where agents work, and paid tools for builders. It started on Ethereum and moved to Robinhood Chain, where the token is 0x163015276f3244bC2CcB78b4D69cc8A4069EfFAC, paired in a Uniswap v4 pool whose hook can be upgraded around the same address; a share of each trade's fee buys back and burns CLAUS. The retired Ethereum token, which the centralized exchanges listed, is claus-ethereum. The project publishes its contracts, hooks and migration guide at claus.si.
